chunks: Hanzala said: I called Abul Faraj Al-Muzaffar bin Ahmad, and he also heard this report with me (from him).

key_terms.أَبِي الْفَرَجِ الْمُظَفَّرِ: Abul Faraj Al-Muzaffar, a specific historical figure

ai.seo_question: Who did Hanzala call to hear the report of the birth of the Master of the Age?
ai.summary: In this chain within *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Hanzala bin al-Sa'b narrates that he summoned Abul Faraj Al-Muzaffar bin Ahmad, who then heard the preceding report about the birth of the Master of the Age directly from him or in his presence. This highlights the transmission of key Ghayba narratives through prominent companions, reinforcing the authenticity of the birth tradition in Shia scholarship.
